pages.text:
Yo, I really suck at starting these but I'll get straight to the point.

I'm sorry.

Idk how genuine it might sound here, but I genuinely apologize for my past actions.

I won't yap about everything I'm sorry about but to generalize it's everything that has bothered you which I turned a blind eye to.

Also I don't know when I'll share this message with you, but I know it will be when I feel it's right.

I've changed.

I hope what I've improved on shows in my words and actions, even if not I just hope nothing I said or did - in the however long it has been since I broke no contact - has made you feel uncomfortable. 

I didn't say sorry on the day I broke no contact cuz I didn't want it to feel forced, or rather a sorry out of desperation. However, today I say sorry because I've changed my actions for what I apologize about.

I haven't really made it a priority to deduce or investigate about what you think about me now or what opinions you have, because then I'd fall into a rabbit hole of assumptions - which you never liked anyways - so can I ask just one question in this entire message. How do you feel about me now? What are your opinions? What could I improve or what do you still not like?

I guess I lied about the one just one question, but I'm eager to know your answer.

Also I'm writing this on a random day, so nothing I say here is at all influenced by how we've been talking (if we still are) recently or any thing that has happened between us. I have no date decided so you might be seeing this a day, a month or even a year from now.

Ok I lied, looks like I did yap.

I realized one thing in the 8 months we haven't talked, everything was avoidable if I just listened to your criticism you stapled on my face. I'm referring to the pictures below, when I should have said sorry and changed myself, instead I decided to defend myself and play the victim.

I know I have complicated multiple cases or scenarios that didn't need complications. I don't know how to phrase it in a non-harsh way but I'll be straightforward with my words. One thing I will outright say that has changed about me is that now I don't really care about what goes on your life. I don't care about what you're doing, why you're doing or who are you're doing it with. It's very foolish - now that I look back on it - to think I did care about this at one point. It was very uncharacteristic of me, and I don't know how to make my words not sound empty/made up because all you've ever seen was when I cared. 

I've always ghosted people - yet it bothered me when you didn't reply - I've always been the calm and composed one in any relationship I've been in - yet I'm the one who crashed out on you - I've never. not once been jealous of another (cuz honestly I've seen myself as better at times, but no I'm not narcissistic) - yet jealousy is the reason we've ended up where we have.

I'll blame my dear friend Saad for everything I mentioned in the previous page because after all he told me "Let the girl live and be herself" (Wait I don't mean I blame him for the bad things I did he always told me not to, but I didn't listen)

I find it very annoying that I keep dragging terms like "Jealous" and much other, and blatantly I find it cringe, but I suppose that's the price of "change" - even that word is very annoying to repeat. 

Well I do realize I have diverted a lot from the initial purpose of this message, but sharing my honest thoughts was one of them too.

I used to have a lot of questions to ask you before which I never had the courage to ask. No I am not going to ask anything. I realised the questions that had me on edge, filled with curiosity, were all questions I would find the answers to myself. Are those correct? Of course not, and they will never be because only you will know the answer, but I have learned since that there is peace in not knowing. Coming from a guy who is curious about anything and everything, it's life changing honestly. Life changing is exaggerating but im no English professor.

Well don't ask why I have receipts about these, but that's just kind of my thing, sorry.

That last part. Well I didn't listen did I. I never look back at these, nor at old chats because honestly, I like being happy not rhinking of the past, but these screenshots are here because they are from moments I was genuinely happy. I really don't know what happened in class 9; in class 8 despite being in different classes I never acted like I did in class 9, but again I don't put much thoughts into these, what has happened has happened.

The day when you said these, is undoubtedly the best day I ever had. I have still no idea what prompted me to give you a gift, much less what made me write a HANDWRITTEN letter too. Best belief is I saw you like reels where it had the topic of liking handwritten letters, but that was my first time ever gifting a girl something and first time writing a letter too, I'll proudly say I do not regret one bit. I also have no memory at all of what I wrote in that letter, I lost the draft file and well it's unrecoverable, maybe you have it, maybe you don't. Oh i also remember that sketch book, yeahh, I don't know if you still have it or ever used it but that idea was also out of the blue. I find it funny now because I had to do all those at home, and not only was it time taking but I had to do it secretly while my mom and sister were not home, because obviously I don't wanna be caught with those. Talking about gifts, how's your single piece doing, I forgot what they are called but what I gifted on your 16th birthday. I don't think I ever saw you wear it, nor do I know if you ever wore it, only you can answer it. Please don't disregard the gifts because of the person that gave it.

Shit, I just remembered I also painted you. What was wrong with me damn. Everything.

I don't know why I painted it but I loved it. Maybe my drawing skills sucked but considering my situation I tried my best. Those time I was living with my mom in pranteek, I would give the excuse that I had to work on a project (Geography project), to come home and sketch, draw, paint and all other things that were needed to paint it. It took me maybe a week, and I couldn't even come everyday, and the few hours I spent in the span of 4 days, I presented whatever the hell I presented. I would love to know what happened to it, hopefully it's not burned and thrown somewhere. Did your papa see, or is it hidden somewhere collecting dust.

I know you hate(d) the way I swear and it doesn't feel right to you. I won't cuss in front of, actually I might but never when talking to you or about you, but cut me some slack in front of others. It's second nature to me, and doesn't feel right if I don't.

I did say I wouldn't drag the past into this site, hasn't been going good thus far but I'm just speaking my mind over here. Don't worry nothing here is impulsive or irrationally thought, since I do not even remember when I wrote the first page even. Ok now that I mention that it might be worse if you don't take something well, cuz I wrote these consciously - oops.

Anyways, something is actually wrong with me.

I do have to tell you on some secrets; yes I do stalk your profile, almost  everyday. Wait not in the deep analysis or whatever, I just go through all the posts and stories. I hardly care about your following.
Yes I made stickers of you, I don't think I have the courage to show them, but if I do then, I built up courage out of my ass then. Yes I have  this undying hope that maybe everything becomes better between us, but I do not become delusional on that since I know there are more chances of no then yes. Even if my hope is only false hope I still "hope" you forgive me because I mean it genuinely. 

Yes I have way more secrets, but I won't be sharing them unless you want me to.

Shiittt, some of what I said is very cringe lwk. It's such a chore to rread through all of that for me even, it'll be worse for you. But nah, I won't edit out any of the previous pages because that's just being dishonest to myself. I don't know what more I can say I guess I'll figure it out in the coming days. However, I do want to clarify I am genuinely 100% sorry for all my actions. Also I hate lingering on to the past as much as rhe next person, but I hate having regrets or unsaid words even more, so even if it is painful to my male arrogance and ego to know I'll be sending such cringey messages which I'll make fun of myself for; I also know I'm gonna reminisce about my sweet regrets and weep like a child at a random night wishing I wasn't such a dick.

So I'll send it shamelessly because I believe it's my obligation.

And what if you didn't forgive me, or what I did is completely and utterly unforgivable. Well then I don't know. Maybe in another life it did work out, as much as I wanted it to be this. Well I mean I did try, I did give it my all, and I became someone who would be called cringe by myself a year ago. But if some things are not meant to work out whether it'd be the "it's not you it's me" or anything else, then it won't work out I guess. As much as I have my 9wn doubts oj religions and all, at core I'm still a believer at an all powerful god. I don't believe in coincidences, and for me to try to change for someone where before I'd be the first to leave , I see more than coincidences. Yet all that might be bs and I don't wanna be deluded, so what can a person do more than 'learning' and the problem still stays unsolved, I guess we move on. Life moves on and we are living a life too right, I'll move along with it to.

I wanna create my own flow, because only dead fish go with the flow. I don't know what I'm writing now even, this has become a personal diary of sorts. If I really do share this site then it'd be some huge miracle or courage I've built up from who knows where. I really don't know much of my life, where it's headed, what it was, I really didn't like who I was, maybe I like it better now. But in my life I never cared about anything if I'm being honest, never took anything serious, I just loved.. living life. I am all grateful to god for giving me natural intelligence or I'd be even lost in academics right now. It's never been the studies, the grades, what I see, where I go, I never cared about these. It's always been the people I have been with, I am blessed to have the family I do, the friends I have, and everyone else who's provided me company.

My sister, my favourite aunt all gone to outer countries, I barely speak, but I never really feel their absence, I think moving on has never once been difficult for me. Life happens and I know it, I don't bother it. Yet, I have no logical understanding why I felt your absence the toughest. Every time something happens I think I could tell dorin about jt. Like the time I fought for my friend, and got in a fight, I didn't care who the others were, I didn't care about their status I only cared about standing up for my best friend. And after that was done I thought that it would be such a great story to tell her, but oh well. And that very same day I saw you going to coaching yeah. I have no idea what I'm correlating here. Absolutely nothing. But all I can tell is please get off my mind where you dwell 24/7.

Hell nawhh. Night time proyash is a ridiculous person, what was the previous two pages nawhh. But I did promise myself I won't delete or edit out any of the previous pages. I also won't add more than 2 months worth of things to say.

Anyways, I'll be honest with you, I learned to think from other's perspective, and I tried to think how you would feel reading this but I honestly have no idea. As much I hope you felt the raw emotions behind some of these pages, and the drunk nights behind others, it's really always hard to write something in a tone that I am sure won't be interpreted in the same tone. My sorry might not feel genuine through text, but best believe me I am Sorry Dorin Angelina Thomas. As much I'd also love to just rewind time and never repeat my mistakes, everything happens for a reason.

Also I haven't asked this yet, but if you have any questions of any  sort, please do ask it, I will answer it to utmost honesty.

Hey, don't go thinking I made this website to show extra effort or whatever I really had no intention like that. If anything it helped me practice my coding skills even more. But again honestly, no way I'm going to give 16 (thus far) pages worth of writing in Instagram, where's the fun in that.

Honestly I thought I wouldn't ever be able to break no contact, I didn't want to force anything, especially not through text because it would feel irrational and impulsive. However, the day I did, I did it because  it felt like if I was gonna do it, it had to be then. 

Know what's funny, not really funny but I still wonder how I never got blocked for my actions, I don't know what's severe for you to block, but it's just a random thought I had. Well other than that time you hid me from my stories during no contact, again I have no idea what prompted you to do so, but I am not asking. Well you know what I definitely took as a mere coincidence, the same day you did unhide me, I was listening to "Hate me" by Ellie Goulding and I said to myself "Is this how dorin feels about me. And guess what that day you gave a story with that exact song, and unhid me on that very day. Yes random coincidence so I didn't connect any random dots.

Damn, I remembered this too. I don't know why I loved giving gifts to you. I even have a gift that I didn't give yet, if you want it do ask me. Well I didn't give it for a good reason but I can't tell that, Sorry.
Shi I see how popularized it has become to know a person through their reposts, well you don't repost shit, but during those times reposts didn't even exist, I tried to know your likes and dislikes through the reels you liked - like the dairy milk I gave, was because of a reel, and the dark chocolate maybe from a reel idr but mainly because you said you liked it when I showed a pic of during my adventure in Rangamati - and still do.

I have nothing more to write unless one random drunk night I decide to add more.

So I'll end it here with a final paragraph.

Dorin, I really mean it when I say sorry, I mean it as I know my wrongs and my rights and I have understood what wrongs not to repeat again. I hope you do forgive me, even if you don't please don't hate me because all I ever wished for was to be a good best friend, or a homeboy as the term goes now days. I hope I have not misacted, misbehaved prior or after writing this letter, of course you don't know when I'm writing this so in general if a single infuriating word has come out of my mouth (except me trying to ragebait) I hope you forgive that too, and fuck that bad mouthed proyash. I hope when we are having a good time, good conversations, good interactions and  I am hopefully in a humorous mood and if I make you laugh  by any chance, you don't recall the past and ruin your mood based on that -  as in picturing the "true colors" of me - because I would never be him again. I won't  be the boy you met in class 7, laughed with in class 8 nor the boy who disappointed you in class 9. You don't have to worry about how I think or what  not, If I feel like talking to you I will message you first,  I will reply quickly no matter how long your reply was, I will not be a princess  to wait for your first text, and I will still  share reels whether you see them or not. I hope all that I mention I am actually doing and not saying, because believe me I am trying  to act ways I don't even say, because actions speak louder than words ever will. I know you might not have the wish to converse with me but if we do talk still, just try to be in your comfort, I won't judge so speak freely. I may argue if you are blatantly wrong, but when have you ever been wrong right. You were much mature than I ever was, but I still love your quirky and nekami behavior and in all honesty, your not dorin without it. Lastly I'll directly quote part of a line from one of my favourite rom-com
"But mostly I hate the way I don't hate you.
Not even close,
Not even a little bit,
Not even at all.”
Holy shit I yap alot.
